text: This study compared the growth of tomato seedlings under red versus blue LED light. Using a small sample of ten plants per group, we monitored height and leaf development over six weeks. While both spectrums supported growth, distinct structural differences emerged, suggesting that even limited trials can offer valuable insights for optimizing indoor agricultural setups.
